capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Subaru: 'a 74.7-kWh lithium-ion battery' shared across the 2027 lineup.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Same 74.7 kWh pack as the 2026 bZ; EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for it. Subaru states only total capacity.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Same 74.7 kWh pack as the 2026 bZ; chief engineer: the 74.7 kWh pack 'retains the same chemistry and cells' (NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: InsideEVs: 2026 Solterra has a '400-volt architecture' (2027 is carried over).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: combines two Subaru sources. The 2027 press kit states a battery preconditioning system with 'improved battery preconditioning'; the navigation-destination or driver-started trigger comes from Subaru's 2026 release (src-subaru-us-media-solterra-2026), and the 2027 car is described as carried over.

dc_max_kw.notes: Subaru 2027 kit: fast-charging speeds up to 150 kW (estimated rate).

published_10_80_min.notes: Subaru 2027 kit: 'Charging from 10% to 80% in about 28 minutes'.
